What it means to be an Eonaut

At Eon, speed isn’t just how we build—it’s who we are. In almost no time, we turned the world’s slowest, most expensive problem into a living, breathing innovation engine. Now, global enterprises use their backups not just for recovery, but for discovery.

Here, every Eonaut makes an impact that shows up in real time. We experiment fearlessly, build fast, and celebrate the wins together. If you’re wired to move first, think deeply, and turn complex challenges into elegant solutions, you’ll fit right in.

How we work, thrive, and win

In other words, the values that make our team unstoppable:

Excellence Above All

We’re building a company that Fortune 500s trust with their most critical infrastructure. That’s why we hire top talent, and hold ourselves to the highest standards. Skill and impact matter more than hierarchy or titles. 

Radical Ownership

At Eon, ownership is our modus operandi. We’re flat by design. That means direct collaboration with the founders, and real authority to make decisions that move the company forward.

Enjoy the Ride

We take fun seriously because happy people build better products. We do everything it takes for our employees to feel supported, rewarded, and have fun along the way.
